headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: VER (9)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Miami Grand Prix from P9 on the grid, 5.4s ahead of Sergio Perez, with Fernando Alonso completing the podium.
Max Verstappen made the biggest climb, from P9 to P1.
Kevin Magnussen had a day to forget, dropping from P4 to P10.
The stewards penalised SAI (5 second time penalty).
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 14 points over Sergio Perez.
